docs.summary: A kinematic character that moves by sweeping its own shape through the world. It walks along the ground, slides along walls and ceilings, climbs steps, snaps down stairs and slopes, and rides whatever it stands on. It never becomes a rigidbody, so pushing things is left to the caller through [`Hits`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.CharacterController~Hits).
The gap kept between the controller and everything it touches, so casts never start inside.
Which layers the controller collides with.
The steepest surface in degrees that can be stood on and walked up.
How far the controller drops to stay on the ground while walking, which is what carries it down stairs and over crests.
The tallest ledge the controller walks straight up onto.
Whether standing on something that moves or turns carries the controller with it.

Which way is up for this controller, the opposite of the gravity the game applies. The shape stands along it, slopes, steps and ceilings are measured against it, and walking runs across it. Set it every frame for gravity that changes, such as walking round a planet.

Changing it turns the controller in place. A small turn pivots about the feet, so they stay planted on a curved world, and a large one about the middle of the shape, so a sudden flip turns the controller over where it is rather than swinging its head through the floor.
How many times a move may push the controller out of geometry it is already inside.
How far past touching a depenetration pushes, so the next cast starts outside.
Whether the controller is standing on something walkable.

Everything the last [`Move`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.CharacterController~Move) touched, in the order it was touched, including what it stands on and anything it had to push out of. Valid until the next move.
Which sides of the controller touched something during the last [`Move`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.CharacterController~Move).

How far the controller travelled in the last [`Move`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.CharacterController~Move) under its own motion, divided by the frame time. Being carried by a platform is not included, that is [`GroundVelocity`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.CharacterController~GroundVelocity).
How fast what the controller stands on carried it during the last move.
How far what the controller stands on turned during the last move.
How many degrees about the up axis what the controller stands on turned during the last move. The controller never turns itself, so add this to whatever facing the game keeps.
The walkable surface normal under the controller, or up when it is not grounded.
The angle in degrees of the surface under the controller, or zero when not grounded.
What the controller is standing on, or null when it is not grounded or the ground owns no collider.
The rigidbody the controller is standing on, or null when it is not grounded.
The middle of the controller's shape in world space.
The bottom of the controller in world space, which is where it stands.
The top of the controller in world space.
Stops the controller colliding with a body that moves with it, such as a part of its ragdoll.
Undoes [`IgnoreCollisionWith`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.CharacterController~IgnoreCollisionWith).
Re-resolves the rigidbody the controller must not collide with. Call after re-parenting, or after adding or removing a Rigidbody3D above this controller.
Called when the object becomes enabled and active. Only called when the GameObject is in a Scene and enabled.
Called when the object becomes disabled or inactive. Only called when the GameObject was in a Scene and becomes disabled.

Moves the controller by `motion`, sliding along whatever it meets. A move that does not rise while grounded walks along the ground, climbing steps and following slopes, and only falls once there is no ground within [`SnapDownDistance`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.CharacterController~SnapDownDistance). Returns which sides were touched, [`Hits`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.CharacterController~Hits) holds what was touched.
Places the controller somewhere without sweeping there, then pushes it out of anything it landed inside. Use this for a spawn or a teleport.
